name: Nguyễn Bỉnh Khiêm
role: Vietnamese administrator and Cao Dai saint
contribution: A Vietnamese administrator, confucianist, poet, prophet and later a saint of the Cao Dai religion and of the new religious movement known as School of Teaching Goodness.

checks.lead: Nguyễn Bỉnh Khiêm (chữ Hán: 阮秉謙; 1491–1585) was a Vietnamese administrator, confucianist, poet, prophet and later a saint of the Cao Dai religion and of the new religious movement known as School of Teaching Goodness.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
